integrity: Analytic proof for every integer m>=1 with supplementary exact enumeration and Sturm checks; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite once-subdivided stars with identical fugacity only; no angular limiting density, arbitrary-spider extension, or thermodynamic phase-transition claim. Earlier general left-half-plane stability and the spider partition formula are explicitly prior work; historical priority for finer root geometry remains open.
title: A universal hard-core zero circle and an exponentially escaping root on subdivided stars
